rawContent: Love and solidarity for @itsmeeshashafi. -- This courageous lady from Karachi calls for solidarity for Meesha and all women who step out of their homes for work, education and to fight for their rights, because she says women have been oppressed for too long in Pakistan. #metoo

Did you get fUnDIng when you worked in Indian movies Al* Z*faR? HRDs/NGos/civil soc. orgs get grants by pitching their proposals for projects. NGOs pay taxes, have internal audits. Their work isn't illegal, they fill gaps on rights work left by govts. #metoo Us to Az 👇🏽 https://t.co/qTvK5njC1v

The inimitable @zalmayzia tell us this super courageous and articulate lady is Pastor Ghazala Shafiq from KHI. Solidarity across faith and class. Beyond impressive. And she is spot on that @itsmeeshashafi's case is important for all women and girls who men dare to harass. #metoo
